name: Billboard Voxelization
definition: A two-pass voxelization technique where the first pass renders billboards (instanced quads) into a position map FBO to initialize voxel positions, writing nearest voxel positions to the position FBO.
summary: Billboard Voxelization renders instanced quads to create a full position map, distinguishing itself by explicitly rendering geometry for depth rather than relying solely on depth or normals.
